root_cause.summary: The Redis container (astronomy-db) restarted and was unavailable, causing the cart service to fail when accessing its storage. This failure propagated up through checkout and payment, leading to an elevated error rate observed at the frontend.

Redis container astronomy-db just restarted 36s ago, indicating possible downtime.

proposed_action.reason: Redis container (astronomy-db) recently restarted and is unavailable, causing cart service to fail to connect to Redis and propagate errors upstream.
